attributes.action: Impeach the current Cabinet for failing to protect our borders
attributes.additional_details: The government is failing in its core duty to protect the British people.
attributes.background: Border protection is one of the most fundamental obligations of government. Good fences make good neighbours. We call upon the government to impeach those members of parliament who have thrown their support behind uncontrolled illegal migration.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government to do. There is no active or legal impeachment process for cabinet ministers in the UK.

We also can't accept petitions calling for elected representatives to be removed from office.
